verdict.rationale: ClickUp's first-party integrations directory says it connects to over 1,000 tools for free. It lists many native integrations spanning Slack, GitHub, GitLab, HubSpot, Salesforce, Figma, Microsoft Teams, Calendly, Sentry, and n8n, which together amount to an app marketplace for workspace connectivity. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the catalog's size and quality, evidence of 'thousands' rather than '1,000+', and documentation of the in-app install and connect flow.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace
